entities.name: Ramesses II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Egyptian pharaoh (c. 1303–1213 BCE), often regarded as the most powerful ruler of Ancient Egypt. Built Abu Simbel, fought the Battle of Kadesh, and signed the first known peace treaty with the Hittites.
